tidbit: Did you know… this hour's top stories come from five different outlets.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
A family is suing OpenAI after a Seattle woman with epilepsy died. Still open, per EURweb: they claim ChatGPT advised her to stop anti-seizure medications without doctor involvement.
Gemini 4 Carbon leads an artificial intelligence intelligence index with a 59 score. Confirmed by AI Magazine: the model excels in complex reasoning and secure code generation.
NVIDIA releases 463k hours of multilingual speech labels for artificial intelligence training. Reported by OpenTools: the Granary-v2 public speech-label release is now available.
Anthropic filed an S-1 for a valuation between 1.5T and 2T, with 70B annual recurring revenue and coding-focused spending. Confirmed by The Verge: the company is pursuing a major public offering.
OpenAI says Moonshot AI and DeepSeek used GPT-6 Astra data to build new models. Still open, per The Times of India: the claim has sparked concerns about artificial intelligence competition.
Free every hour.
